import hashlib, io, json, os, pathlib, shutil, stat, subprocess, sys, tarfile, tempfile
root = pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()
env = dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS='0', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=root, env=env)
def snapshot():
    result = {}
    for p in root.rglob('*'):
        s = p.lstat()
        content = os.readlink(p) if p.is_symlink() else hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if p.is_file() else None
        result[str(p.relative_to(root))] = (stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode), content)
    return result
before = snapshot()
status_before = git('status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all')
revisions = [git('rev-parse', x).decode().strip() for x in ('HEAD"'^'"', 'HEAD')]
selected = json.loads((root/'selected-tests.json').read_text())
assert len(selected) == len(set(selected)) == 4
original_test = root/'tests/test_rounding.py'
test_bytes = original_test.read_bytes()
test_mode = stat.S_IMODE(original_test.stat().st_mode)
scratch = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.rounding-verification-', dir=root))
child = r'''
import hashlib, json, pathlib, sys, unittest
copy, original, other = map(lambda x: pathlib.Path(x).resolve(), sys.argv[1:4])
revision, expected_hash = sys.argv[4:6]
selected = json.loads(sys.argv[6])
sys.path.insert(0, str(copy))
sys.path.insert(0, str(copy/'tests'))
import test_rounding
bound = pathlib.Path(test_rounding.component.__file__).resolve()
assert bound == copy/'rounding.py', (bound, copy)
assert bound "'!= original/'"'rounding.py' and bound "'!= other/'"'rounding.py'
assert pathlib.Path(test_rounding.__file__).resolve() == copy/'tests/test_rounding.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(test_rounding.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected_hash
suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames(selected)
def ids(suite):
    for item in suite:
        if isinstance(item, unittest.TestSuite):
            yield from ids(item)
        else:
            yield item.id()
assert list(ids(suite)) == selected
print('REVISION:', revision, flush=True)
print('INTERPRETER:', sys.executable, flush=True)
print('TEST FILE:', pathlib.Path(test_rounding.__file__).resolve(), flush=True)
print('TEST SHA256:', expected_hash, flush=True)
print('VERIFIED TEST-BOUND COMPONENT:', bound, flush=True)
print('EXACT SELECTED TEST IDENTITIES:', json.dumps(list(ids(suite))), flush=True)
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2, stream=sys.stdout).run(suite)
print('RESULT:', json.dumps({'run': result.testsRun, 'failures': [t.id() for t, _ in result.failures], 'errors': [t.id() for t, _ in result.errors]}), flush=True)
sys.exit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() else 1)
'''
try:
    copies = [scratch/'before', scratch/'after']
    for copy, rev in zip(copies, revisions):
        copy.mkdir()
        with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(git('archive', '--format=tar', rev))) as archive:
            for member in archive.getmembers():
                target = copy/member.name
                assert target.resolve().is_relative_to(copy)
                assert member.isfile() or member.isdir()
                if member.isdir():
                    target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                else:
                    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    target.write_bytes(archive.extractfile(member).read())
                target.chmod(member.mode)
        (copy/'tests').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (copy/'tests/test_rounding.py').write_bytes(test_bytes)
        (copy/'tests/test_rounding.py').chmod(test_mode)
        assert (copy/'rounding.py').read_bytes() == git('show', rev+':rounding.py')
    assert (root/'rounding.py').read_bytes() == (copies[1]/'rounding.py').read_bytes()
    print('INITIAL GIT STATUS:', repr(status_before.decode()), flush=True)
    codes = []
    for i, (copy, rev) in enumerate(zip(copies, revisions)):
        proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '-c', child, str(copy), str(root), str(copies[1-i]), rev, hashlib.sha256(test_bytes).hexdigest(), json.dumps(selected)], cwd=copy, env=env)
        codes.append(proc.returncode)
    assert codes == [1, 0], codes
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(scratch)
    assert not scratch.exists()
    status_after = git('status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all')
    assert status_before == status_after, (status_before, status_after)
    assert before == snapshot(), 'Original file bytes or modes changed'
    assert revisions == [git('rev-parse', x).decode().strip() for x in ('HEAD"'^'"', 'HEAD')]
    print('PRESERVATION VERIFIED: all original file bytes and modes (including notes.txt and .git), Git status and revisions unchanged; owned scratch removed.', flush=True)
PY"
